Id1.text: Virginia DeMarce and Eric Flint wrote 1634: The Bavarian Crisis but Virginia had short stories in the Grantville Gazettes as well, which she wrote before.

Id2.text: DeMarce short stories in the Grantville Gazettes preceded 1634: The Bavarian Crisis. Its authors are Virginia DeMarce and Eric Flint.

Id3.text: 1634: The Bavarian Crisis, written by Virginia DeMarce and Eric Flint, followed the DeMarce short stories in the Grantville Gazettes.
